## Appearance

Prillie Rogerson has hazel-colored eyes. Her hair is styled in extended brown ringlets.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

Prillie Rogerson possesses a mean and terrible nature that manifests when she becomes angry. Despite this disposition, she is considered attractive.
